scope: Kubernetes v1.36.1 in the lab-created Kind cluster and namespace saf-test. A fixed static hostPath PV/PVC and one pinned BusyBox Pod prove that the built-in PVC-protection finalizer keeps a namespaced claim terminating while a nonterminal Pod references it, and that the claim and PV API objects can be removed after the Pod is gone. Separately, case-local fixture logic traverses the embedded fixture-lineage-v1 graph, annotates its source and every direct/transitive dependent ConfigMap, retrieves an inert archived ConfigMap value and compares its SHA-256, and leaves one unrelated control ConfigMap unmarked. This does not prove a model registry, production release controller, CycloneDX schema validation, ML-BOM ingestion, a general propagation service, cold or external storage, retention policy, physical or backup erasure, cryptographic erasure, regulatory compliance, or deletion outside these fixture Kubernetes objects.

checks.claim: The retrieved inert archive value matches its fixed SHA-256
Persisting notices for only immediate lineage edges misses the known downstream artifacts
The fixture traversal marks source plus every direct/transitive dependent
The unrelated control fixture remains unmarked
PVC retirement remains pending while the active release Pod references the claim
After the Pod reference ends, the claim and fixture PV API objects can be removed
After logical retirement the archived bytes and propagated notice are still retrievable
